block_adherence_90.description: Finished a block with at least 90 % of its prescribed sets done.

rest_days_cycle.name: Every rest day respected
rest_days_cycle.description: A cycle in which every prescribed rest day was respected.

first_100km_month.description: Ran 100 kilometres in one calendar month.

first_100mi_month.name: First 100 mi month
first_100mi_month.description: Ran 100 miles in one calendar month.

bodyweight_bench.name: Bodyweight bench
bodyweight_bench.description: Bench pressed your own body weight.

swim_1km_session.description: Swam a kilometre in a single session.

swim_1mi_session.name: 1 mi swum in one session
swim_1mi_session.description: Swam a mile in a single session.

set_row.previous: {rir_recorded, select, yes {{weight} × {reps} @{rir} last time} other {{weight} × {reps} last time}}

line_chart.summary: {title}, {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}, {first} to {last}. {has_values, select, yes {Highest {highest}.} other {Nothing to plot yet.}}

workout.none_body: Start one, and every set is saved as you tap it.
workout.empty_body: Add an exercise to start logging sets.
workout.set_type_note: Warm-up, drop and back-off sets are logged, and not counted in volume or records.
workout.rest_hint: Off means no rest timer. A rest set here lasts for the rest of this workout.

finish.title: Finish the workout
finish.ticked: {count, plural, one {# set ticked} other {# sets ticked}}
finish.unticked: {count, plural, one {# set not ticked. It stays as it is and counts for nothing.} other {# sets not ticked. They stay as they are and count for nothing.}}
finish.fatigue_hint: Optional, 1 to 10. For your own history. It never changes a plan.
finish.nothing_ticked: Nothing was ticked, so there is nothing to finish.

summary.title: Workout finished
summary.subtitle: {title} · {day}
summary.unticked: {count, plural, one {# set not ticked} other {# sets not ticked}}
summary.records_title: {count, plural, one {New personal record} other {New personal records}}

history.title: History
history.empty_body: Finish a workout and it appears here, with every set as you logged it.
history.counted_sets: {count, plural, =0 {no counted sets} one {# counted set} other {# counted sets}}
history.records_title: {count, plural, one {Record this workout still holds} other {Records this workout still holds}}
history.records_none: This workout holds no record today.
history.records_note: Judged against every other workout you finished, whatever its date.
history.charts_empty: Nothing to chart yet: no counted set here has a load.
history.charts_time_distance: Time and distance are listed session by session. They are not charted yet.
history.sessions_empty: No finished workout has this exercise yet.
history.archived_note: Hidden from the exercise picker. Its history stays as it was.
history.e1rm_note: A set logged without RIR has no estimated 1RM, so it leaves a gap rather than a zero.

past.title: Log a past workout
past.note: For a workout you did but did not log. Its sets are dated to when it ended, and no rest timer runs.
past.end_before_start: The end must be after the start.

catalog.title: Exercises
catalog.search_hint: Portuguese or English — both find the same exercise.
catalog.empty_body: Try a shorter search, or clear the filters.
catalog.hidden_note: Hidden exercises stay out of the picker. Everything you logged with them is untouched.
catalog.hidden_global_note: Hiding a built-in exercise only affects this device.
catalog.fork_note: Built-in exercises can't be changed. Saving makes your own copy, and the original stays as it is.
catalog.field_bodyweight_hint: Pull-ups and dips: your body weight counts toward the load.
catalog.name_taken: You already have an exercise with this name.

routine.title: Routines
routine.field_folder_hint: Optional. Routines in the same folder are listed together.
routine.archived_note: Archived routines keep every workout started from them.
routine.archived_empty: You have not archived any routine.
routine.empty_body: A routine is a list of exercises with targets. Start one and every set comes pre-filled from last time.
routine.open_workout: A workout is in progress. Finish it before starting another.
routine.exercises_empty: Add the exercises this routine is made of.
routine.field_rir_hint: Shown beside each set as a target. It is never logged for you.
routine.problem_sets: Sets must be a whole number from 1 to 50.
routine.problem_reps: Reps must be a whole number.
routine.problem_rep_range: The minimum cannot be above the maximum.
routine.problem_rest: That rest is out of range.

register.title: Create your account
register.password_hint: At least 10 characters. A few words you will remember work well.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.request_sent: If an account uses {email}, a link to reset its password is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
reset.zones_warning: Resetting your password removes your privacy zones. They are encrypted with your password, so nobody can recover them, including us. You can draw them again afterwards.
reset.confirm_submit: Reset password and remove privacy zones
reset.done: Your password is reset and every device is signed out. Sign in with your new password.

password.title: Change your password
password.done: Your password is changed. Your other devices stay signed in.

email.title: Change your email
email.sent: We sent a link to {email}. Your address changes when you open it.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.what: Deleting your account removes it from our servers with everything in it: workouts, activities, plans, progress and settings.
delete.grace: It is deleted 7 days after you ask. Until then you can cancel from any device where you are signed in.
delete.final: After those 7 days it cannot be undone.
delete.pending: You asked to delete this account on {date}. It is deleted 7 days after that, unless you cancel.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match an account.
errors.email_unavailable: An account already uses this email. Sign in, or reset its password.
errors.password_breached: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose another one.
errors.password_incorrect: Your current password is not right.
errors.invalid_token: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.offline: No connection. Try again when you are online.
errors.signed_out: You have been signed out. Sign in again.
errors.privacy_key_missing: This device does not hold your privacy key, so your password cannot be changed here. Change it on a device where you signed in with your password.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email for CyberAthlete
verify_email.body:
Hi {name},

Confirm that this address belongs to your CyberAthlete account by opening this link on your phone:

{link}

The link works for 24 hours. If you did not create an account, ignore this email.

password_reset.subject: Reset your CyberAthlete password
password_reset.body:
Hi {name},

Someone asked to reset the password for this account. If it was you, open this link on your phone within 30 minutes:

{link}

Resetting your password removes your privacy zones. They are encrypted with your password, and nobody, including us, can recover them. You can draw them again afterwards.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.

password_changed.subject: Your CyberAthlete password was changed
password_changed.body:
Hi {name},

The password for your account was just changed. If this was you, there is nothing to do.

If it was not, reset your password from the sign-in screen straight away.

email_changed.subject: Your CyberAthlete email address was changed
email_changed.body:
Hi {name},

The email address for your account was changed from this address to {new_email}. If this was you, there is nothing to do.

If it was not, your account may be in someone else's hands: sign in, change your password and sign out every other device.

new_device.subject: New sign-in to your CyberAthlete account
new_device.body:
Hi {name},

Your account was just signed in on a new device: {device}.

If this was you, there is nothing to do. If it was not, change your password and sign that device out from your list of signed-in devices.

refresh_reuse.subject: A device was signed out of your CyberAthlete account
refresh_reuse.body:
Hi {name},

The sign-in on one of your devices was used in a way that suggests it was copied, so that device has been signed out. You will need to sign in on it again.

If you did not expect this, change your password.

deletion_link.subject: Confirm the deletion of your CyberAthlete account
deletion_link.body:
Hi {name},

Someone asked to delete the CyberAthlete account that uses this address. If it was you, open this link within 30 minutes and confirm:

{link}

Nothing is deleted until you confirm, and the account is deleted 7 days after that, so there is still time to change your mind.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your account stays as it is.

deletion_requested.subject: Your CyberAthlete account will be deleted
deletion_requested.body:
Hi {name},

We received a request to delete your CyberAthlete account. It will be deleted on or after {date}, with everything in it: workouts, activities, plans and progress.

To keep your account, sign in to the app before then and cancel the deletion. Your other devices stay signed in, so you can cancel from any of them.

If you did not ask for this, sign in, cancel the deletion and change your password.

deletion_cancelled.subject: Your CyberAthlete account will not be deleted
deletion_cancelled.body:
Hi {name},

The deletion of your account was cancelled. Everything stays as it was.

If you did not cancel it, someone else may be signed in to your account: change your password and sign out every other device.

account_deleted.subject: Your CyberAthlete account was deleted
account_deleted.body:
Hi {name},

Your CyberAthlete account and everything in it have been deleted, as you asked. This is the last email we send to this address.

You can create a new account with this address at any time.

account_deletion.title: Delete your CyberAthlete account
account_deletion.intro: Enter the email address of the account you want to delete. We will send a confirmation link to that address. Nothing is deleted until you open it and confirm.
account_deletion.request_sent: If an account uses that address, a confirmation link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
account_deletion.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
account_deletion.confirm_intro: Your account and everything in it, including workouts, activities, plans and progress, will be deleted 7 days after you confirm. Until then you can cancel by signing in to the app. After that it cannot be undone.
account_deletion.scheduled: Your account will be deleted on or after {date}. To keep it, sign in to the app before then and cancel the deletion.
account_deletion.invalid_link: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
